description: Introducing the Baseus Auto-care spray, the perfect solution for keeping your car's interior clean and fresh. This 300ml spray is specially designed for automotive use and is ideal for cleaning and refreshing your car's interior. The white color of the spray adds a touch of elegance to your car's interior. The Baseus Auto-care spray is easy to use and provides long-lasting freshness. Simply spray it on the desired area and wipe it off with a clean cloth. This spray is perfect for use on car seats, carpets, and other interior surfaces. With its powerful cleaning formula, it effectively removes dirt, stains, and odors, leaving your car's interior looking and smelling like new. Trust Baseus Auto-care spray to keep your car's interior clean and fresh.
